attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: tts_playback_with_sentence_highlighting

steps:
  - id: receive_cleaned_text
    op: receive_input
    params:
      input_type: cleaned_text_sections
      description: Receive the cleaned text sections ready for TTS playback
    output: text_sections

  - id: split_into_sentences
    op: tokenize_sentences
    params:
      source: "{{text_sections}}"
      strategy: sentence_boundary_detection
      locale: fr-FR
      description: Split each section into individual sentences for the utterance queue
    output: sectioned_sentences

  - id: create_utterances
    op: create_speech_synthesis_utterances
    params:
      source: "{{sectioned_sentences}}"
      engine: browser_native_web_speech_api
      lang: fr-FR
      rate: "{{user_config.rate | default(1.0)}}"
      pitch: "{{user_config.pitch | default(1.0)}}"
      description: Create a SpeechSynthesisUtterance for each sentence with user-configured rate and pitch
    output: utterance_list

  - id: apply_inter_section_pauses
    op: insert_pauses_between_sections
    params:
      utterances: "{{utterance_list}}"
      sections: "{{sectioned_sentences}}"
      pause_duration_ms: "{{user_config.inter_section_pause_ms | default(800)}}"
      description: Insert a configurable silence pause between the last utterance of one section and the first utterance of the next
    output: utterance_queue

  - id: queue_utterances
    op: enqueue_to_speech_api
    params:
      utterances: "{{utterance_queue}}"
      api: window.speechSynthesis
      method: speak
      description: Queue all utterances (including pause placeholders) to the browser Web Speech API
    output: playback_handle

  - id: highlight_and_scroll_on_utterance_start
    op: bind_utterance_events
    params:
      utterances: "{{utterance_queue}}"
      event: onstart
      actions:
        - action: highlight_sentence
          params:
            css_class: tts-active-sentence
            clear_previous: true
            target: "{{current_utterance.sentence_element_id}}"
        - action: scroll_into_view
          params:
            target: "{{current_utterance.sentence_element_id}}"
            behavior: smooth
            block: center
      description: As each utterance begins, highlight the corresponding sentence in the UI and scroll it into the viewport
    output: event_bindings
